title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg is Hiding the DRAGON? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the dragon? Watch until the end for the big reveal! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON!
Is it the blue egg, the red egg, or the golden egg?
scenes.visual_prompt: blue red gold Easter eggs row

scenes.narration: Pick your egg! Your answer is locked in! Three… two… one!
The blue egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
scenes.visual_prompt: cracked blue Easter egg rubber duck

scenes.narration: The red egg opens and… oh no, it's just a pile of glitter! Poof!
The golden egg starts to shake… it cracks… and out comes a baby DRAGON! ROAAR!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — can you beat it?
